title: Preallocate vector rebuild data prefixes
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when Fusion storage vector-index rebuild scans build data:<table>: prefixes from known table-name length.
implementation: Added vector_rebuild_data_prefix_for_table() with explicit capacity for data:<table>:.
Replaced FusionStorage::rebuild_vector_index data scan prefix construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: Vector-index rebuild data-prefix construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving HNSW rebuild scanning, row-id extraction, batch insertion, and SQL query behavior.
